items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: I remember taking my wife to see Lionel Hampton at the municipal auditorium.

ctx.x: So what, what, um, as, when you were dating, when you go out, what, what, what dances were popular then?

Oh, the jitterbug, jitterbug. And I was a pretty good jitterbug. Oh, wow. I danced pretty good. I danced pretty good. And, uh, we used to go to the, we used to go to the show. I remember, I remember taking my wife to see Lionel Hampton at the municipal auditorium. And I remember one comment he made, and it stands out in my mind too. You know, uh, the whites were downstairs and we were upstairs. You said generally how it was.
